title: Underwear
html:
Underwear is a common Underwear.

Properties

  •  Underwear
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 0.1 kg (0.2 lb)
  •  Price: 6 gp

Where to find

  • Player character's starting underwear

Notes

  • The appearance of the underwear differs depending on the character's race.
  • Underwear cannot be looted regularly. A party member must pick up the corpse to loot the underwear.
